tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Mother's Day Gifts. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag (null until real Associates IDs), defaultDomain, catalogCount. Use this first to discover service status. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts via GET /api/v1/marketplaces (domain, label, tagConfigured). Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/catalog/resolve.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search Amazon for Mother's Day / Mors dag gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise Mother's Day search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the end user. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: suggest_gifts
tools.description: Alias of search_gifts — suggest Mother's Day gift ideas for a query on the user's marketplace. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated Mother's Day gift starters. On amazon.se items may include /dp/ASIN links when ASINs exist; on other marketplaces catalogMode is search-ideas. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Search (search_gifts) remains primary discovery. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or Mother's Day search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Does not invent Associates tags — omits tag= until server-configured real IDs. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create a Mother's Day gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id — always use the latest. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated Mother's Day (Mors dag) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a Mother's Day wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Fetch a Mother's Day wishlist by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to a Mother's Day wishlist. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: create_wishlist, add_wishlist_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
